full_description: Catch two interleaved falling object types into two color-coded bowls: the left arm holds a blue bowl for type-A objects (biased to fall left), the right arm holds a red bowl for type-B objects (biased to fall right). Classify each falling object, slide the matching bowl under it, and catch it into the correct bowl.
schema: {A} notifies the blue bowl held by the left arm (catches type-A), {B} notifies the red bowl held by the right arm (catches type-B), {a} notifies that both arms act simultaneously
preference: num of words should not exceed 16. Degree of detail avg is 6
